english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose way to say that someone puts others before themselves.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying someone is not selfish.

examples.english: They always think of others first; they are truly selfless.
examples.traditional: 佢成日先諗人哋，真係唔自私。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sin1 nam2 jan4 dei6 zan1 hai6 m4 zi6 si1

examples.english: They are unselfish and always share good things with others.
examples.traditional: 佢做人唔自私，有好嘢一定同人分享。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jan4 m4 zi6 si1 jau5 hou2 je5 jat1 ding6 tung4 jan4 fan1 hoeng2
